Questions

Before you buy

Running costs, water care, bases, installation and warranty. If yours is not here, the team is always happy to help.

How long does it take to arrive?

Typically 4 to 8 weeks from order confirmation, depending on specification. We keep you updated throughout. TBC

What base do I need?

A solid, flat, load bearing surface: a concrete pad, paving or reinforced decking. It must be level and able to take the full weight of the tub when filled with water and bathers.

What electrics do I need?

Electric models need a dedicated 32A or 40A supply fitted by a qualified electrician before installation. Wood fired models need no electrical connection.

Can you install in a difficult location?

Yes. We can arrange crane lifts and specialist access. Please get in touch before ordering so we can advise. A clear access path of at least 90 cm is needed.

How do I keep the water clean?

Regular treatment with chlorine or bromine plus a pH balancer. UV purification and MicroSilk are available as upgrades to make water care simpler.

How often should I change the water?

Every 3 to 4 months with regular use, more often with heavy use. Full instructions and a water care starter kit come with every tub.

What does an electric tub cost to run?

It depends on model, insulation and use. A well insulated electric tub typically costs £30 to £80 a month to hold temperature, and a heat pump brings that down considerably. TBC

Can I use it in winter?

Yes. Every Vale tub is designed for year round outdoor use in the UK climate. Full insulation packages and quality covers hold the heat in cold weather.
